## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is `you/kind-something`, e.g. `finn/feat-something`

- [ ] Every folder you touched still has a `.folderinfo`
- [ ] New files start with `// owner: you` + `// goal: why`
- [ ] `pnpm format && pnpm check` pass
- [ ] AI-assisted work is labelled and delineated, per [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
